name: chatmate
description: Connects your AI to your Telegram through your personal ChatMate bot: read the chats you connected, give tasks in the bot, and get answers, drafts and results back in Telegram.

interface.shortDescription: Your Telegram chats in the conversation
interface.longDescription: Connect your personal ChatMate bot and the Telegram chats you choose. Read photos and documents on demand. Find people by current or earlier names, read both sides of conversations, follow explicit replies and mentions, and expand word forms within selected people/chats and dates. At your explicit request, send text or stored media/stickers, react, manage your own sent messages, copy/forward, share places/contacts/dice, create polls, manage Business checklists and pin messages. Telegram rights and source limits apply. History keeps 60 days from connection.
defaultPrompt: Set up ChatMate so I can send tasks in my Telegram bot and receive replies there.
What did people write to me on Telegram today?
Find the message where we agreed on the price.
